1. This Ordinance may be cited as the Federal

2. In this Ordinance—

(2) The officer for the time being appointed to be the
Federal Lands Commissioner and his successors in
office shall be a body corporate under the name of "the
Federal Lands Commissioner" (hereinafter called "the
Corporation").

(3) The Corporation may sue And be sued in its said
name and shall have perpetual succession and a
